'''''Glory of Kamgeddon''''' was a [[cathedral ship]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Humanocentrism|anti-alien]] [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] that were instigated by the [[Pius Dea]] faith that controlled the Republic. It shared its name with the [[Kamgeddon system/Legends|Kamgeddon system]]. In modern [[Time/Legends|times]], the name ''Glory of Kamgeddon'' continued to evoke dread on the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] it once held captive.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Glory of Kamgeddon'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
